message.content: You are adding MARKETING POLISH (testimonials, trust badges, newsletter capture, and image optimization) to the Nxeon VPS platform marketing site at /opt/nxeon. THREE other agents are editing OTHER areas concurrently; ONLY touch YOUR OWNED FILES. ## CODEBASE PRIMER - Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Prisma. `"use server"` files export ONLY async functions. - Prisma: `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. NEW model `NewsletterSubscriber { id, email(unique), source, createdAt }`. - Design system (globals.css): `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.input`, gradient text via `bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-400 to-brand-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent`. Dark premium theme, slate text. Sections helpers: `import { SectionHeading, CtaBand } from "@/components/marketing/sections"`; reveal-on-scroll: `import { Reveal } from "@/components/marketing/Reveal"`. - READ FIRST: `app/page.tsx` (the landing page — you edit it), `components/marketing/sections.tsx`, `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx` (you edit it), `components/marketing/GameServers.tsx` (for card style), and any existing `` usages in marketing components. - Keep all claims TRUTHFUL: Nxeon is a new, single-node (Singapore) host — do NOT invent fake customer names, star counts, or press logos. Testimonials must be clearly generic/aspirational or framed as sample use-cases, NOT fabricated real people/companies. Trust badges should reflect real facts (NVMe, Let's Encrypt SSL, DDoS-filtered network, dedicated-IP option, instant deploy, Stripe-secured payments) — no fake certifications. ## WHAT TO BUILD 1. **Testimonials / social-proof section** on the landing page — tasteful, honest (e.g. use-case quotes or "what you can run" cards), matching the premium dark theme. No fabricated real identities. 2. **Trust badges row** — real, factual badges (SSL, NVMe, DDoS protection, 24/7, money-back or SLA if truthful, Stripe-secured). Icons via inline SVG or existing `components/marketing/icons`. 3. **Newsletter capture** — a `NewsletterSignup` component (email input) used in the footer and optionally a landing CTA; `subscribe(email)` server action upserts a `NewsletterSubscriber` (dedupe on unique email; validate with zod; friendly success/duplicate messaging). No external ESP. 4. **Image optimization** — replace raw `` in marketing components you own with `next/image` where straightforward (set width/height or `fill`); if an image is decorative/remote and not easily migratable, leave it and note it. Do NOT touch non-marketing files. ## YOUR OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these) - CREATE: `components/marketing/Testimonials.tsx`, `components/marketing/TrustBadges.tsx`, `components/marketing/NewsletterSignup.tsx` (`"use client"`), `lib/actions-newsletter.ts` (`"use server"`: `subscribe`). - EDIT (sole owner): `app/page.tsx` (mount Testimonials + TrustBadges + optional newsletter CTA; migrate any `` here to `next/image`), `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx` (add the newsletter signup). ## HARD RULES - NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, components/portal/Shell.tsx, components/marketing/MarketingHeader.tsx, lib/auth.ts, lib/db.ts, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, app/sitemap.ts, or any file not in your owned list. (Another agent owns MarketingHeader.) - Do NOT run `npm run build`, `prisma db push/migrate/generate`, or restart services. Do NOT git commit/push. No new npm deps. - `"use server"` files export ONLY async functions. Keep copy honest — no fabricated people, companies, logos, or certifications. ## FINAL REPORT Files created/edited; what the testimonials/badges/newsletter contain (confirm nothing fabricated); which `` were migrated to next/image and which were left + why; any INTEGRATION NEEDED.
